references.text: Balaam gives the same instruction to Balak earlier in the story—to build seven altars and prepare seven bulls and seven rams. This shows a recurring pattern in Balaam's sacrificial practice.
At the second blessing, Balak and Balaam repeat the same ritual with seven altars, seven bulls, and seven rams.
Job's friends are asked to offer seven bulls and seven rams, the same number that Balaam required. The number seven symbolizes perfection in sacrifices.
